| 77 | <code>[RAGFlow](https://ragflow.io/) is a leading open-source Retrieval-Augmented Generation ([RAG](https://ragflow.io/basics/what-is-rag)) engine that fuses cutting-edge RAG with Agent capabilities to create a superior context layer for LLMs. It offers a streamlined RAG workflow adaptable to enterprises of any scale.
